sections.title: 1. Definition
sections.html:
In these General Conditions:

  • “Customer” means the principal (person giving the order) or whomsoever is acting on their behalf.
  • “Contract” means the contract between the Customer and SDG Railway with a view to shipping one or more Loading Unit(s) simultaneously, formalized by the Customer’s booking request and confirmation of this booking by SDG Railway Service.
  • “Terminal Manager” means the subcontractor(s) of SDG Railway charged with accepting, handling, loading/unloading, and delivery of the Loading Units on and off the railcars at the agreed departure and arrival terminals.
  • “Interchange” means the document completed by SDG Railway Service or any person appointed by the same, on Handover and on Delivery which contains a statement on the external condition of the UTC.
  • “Delivery” means the action whereby the Loading Unit is placed at the Customer’s disposal for collection at the destination terminal at the agreed date and time.
  • "SDG Railway" means the private company governed by Spanish law with capital of EUR 40,000, registered on the trade and companies of Barcelona under number XXXXXXXX, with its registered office at Moll Drassanes.
  • “Goods” means the property, material, and equipment of any nature whatsoever accommodated in the Loading Units with a view to their carriage.
  • “Loading Unit” or “UTC” means a standard road semi-trailer, swap-body, or container containing the Goods and complying with European standards (including directives 96/53/CEE and 97/27/CEE) which, after loading onto a Railcar, complies with the constraints of the gauge on the line used, as communicated to the customer on the signature of the contract and readable on the website www.sdgrailway.com
  • “Handover” means the act by which the Customer transfers the Loading Unit to SDG Railway Service at the departure terminal.
  • “Fares” means the basic fare scheme communicated to the Customer when enquiring about a booking.
  • “Railcars” mean the railcars used for the carriage of the Loading Units by rail.

sections.title: 2. Obligations of the Parties
sections.html:
2.1. Obligations of SDG Railway
  • Organize and arrange the carriage of the UTC entrusted by the Customer by rail, from the agreed place of collection to the agreed place of destination.
  • Organize reception facilities and access to each terminal for the road units for handover of the UTC on the parking area provided for the purpose and to check the overall size.
  • Organize and oversee operations for the Terminal Manager to load the UTC onto the Railcars at departure.
  • Organize and oversee operations for the Terminal Manager to unload the UTC from the Railcars upon arrival.
  • If transport resources are unavailable on Handover Day, load the UTC as soon as possible onto the next train.
  • Inform the Customer of the latest Handover time at the departure terminal, the number of the loading train, the time at which the UTC will be available for Delivery at the arrival terminal, and any changes to the timetable.
2.2. Obligations of the Customer
  • Ensure the safe detachment or reattachment of the Loading Unit to the traction vehicle, including bolting and unbolted of securing devices and any necessary adaptations for carriage by rail or road haulage. The Customer is responsible for properly detaching or reattaching the Loading Unit to the traction vehicle, following all safety procedures, and making any necessary adaptations required for rail or road haulage.
  • Comply with the internal operating procedures and safety instructions posted at the departure and arrival terminals. The Customer must adhere to all internal operating procedures and safety instructions that are posted at the departure and arrival terminals of SDG Railway Service.
  • Not exceed the total weight of the UTC declared when booking. The Customer must not exceed the total weight of the Loading Unit as declared during the booking process. Any weight exceeding the declared weight may result in additional charges or refusal of transport.
  • Pay the price to SDG Railway Service in accordance with the agreed payment terms. The Customer is responsible for making payment to SDG Railway Service for the services rendered, in accordance with the agreed-upon payment terms.
  • Conduct proper checks, express reasoned reservations, and take necessary actions in case of loss, damage, harm, or delay suffered by the UTC and/or the Goods to preserve legal recourse and confirm reservations in the legal forms and periods, failing which no action may be brought against SDG Railway Service or its substitutes.
  • The Customer must conduct proper checks of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods upon Delivery, and in case of any loss, damage, harm, or delay, must express reasoned reservations and take necessary actions to preserve legal recourse. Failure to do so within the legal forms and periods may result in the Customer losing the right to bring any action against SDG Railway Service or its substitutes.

sections.title: 3. Entry into Force of the Contract
sections.html:
The Contract takes effect upon acceptance by SDG Railway Service of a booking request made by the Customer. The Contract between the Customer and SDG Railway Service comes into effect upon the acceptance of a booking request by SDG Railway Service.

3.1. SDG Railway’s liability

SDG Railway’s liability for losses, damage, or delays takes effect only on the Handover of the UTC at the departure terminal on the day of transportation. SDG Railway Service’s liability for any losses, damages, or delays related to the Loading Unit and/or the Goods begins only upon the Handover of the Loading Unit at the departure terminal on the day of transportation. SDG Railway Service will not be liable for losses or damages that may occur in case of early Handover at the departure terminal before the date of transportation, which is solely the responsibility of the Customer.

sections.title: 4. End of Contract
sections.html: The Contract ends on the date of Delivery at the destination terminal. The Contract between the Customer and SDG Railway comes to an end on the date of Delivery of the Loading Unit at the destination terminal. If the Customer fails to take Delivery of the Loading Unit at the agreed place and date, the Loading Unit will be considered abandoned, and SDG Railway may take appropriate action for the disposition of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods.

sections.title: 5. Prices and Payment Terms
sections.html:
• 5.1. The prices for the combined international road-rail haulage services will be communicated to the Customer upon inquiry about booking. The prices for the combined international road-rail haulage services will be provided to the Customer upon inquiry during the booking process.
  • 5.2. Payment terms will be agreed upon between the Customer and SDG Railway Service. The payment terms for the services rendered by SDG Railway Service will be mutually agreed upon between the Customer and SDG Railway.
  • 5.3. If the Customer fails to pay the agreed-upon price or any other amount due to SDG Railway, SDG Railway may retain possession of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods until payment is received. If the Customer fails to pay the agreed-upon price or any other amounts due to SDG Railway, SDG Railway may retain possession of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods until payment is received in full.
  • 5.4. Any bank charges, taxes, or other fees related to the payment of the services shall be borne by the Customer. The Customer is responsible for any bank charges, taxes, or other fees related to the payment of the services rendered by SDG Railway Service.
  • 5.5. SDG Railway reserves the right to modify prices and payment terms at any time, provided that any changes will be communicated to the Customer in writing and will not affect bookings already confirmed. SDG Railway reserves the right to modify prices and payment terms at any time, but any changes will be communicated to the Customer in writing and will not affect bookings that have already been confirmed.

sections.title: 6. Liability
sections.html:
• 6.1. SDG Railway’s liability is limited to the transport of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods and does not extend to the contents of the Loading Unit. SDG Railway’s liability is limited to the transport of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods as a whole and does not extend to the contents of the Loading Unit.
  • 6.2. SDG Railway’s liability is limited to direct damages caused by its own fault or negligence and does not cover indirect, consequential, or punitive damages. SDG Railway’s liability is limited to direct damages that are caused by its own fault or negligence and does not cover indirect, consequential, or punitive damages.
  • 6.3. SDG Railway’s liability is limited to the value of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods at the time and place of Handover, or the declared value if higher, and is subject to applicable international conventions and local laws. SDG Railway’s liability is limited to the value of the Loading Unit and/or the Goods at the time and place of Handover, or the declared value if higher, and is subject to applicable international conventions and local laws.

sections.title: 7. Unauthorized Goods
sections.html:
• 7.1. Class 1, 2, 5.2 and 7 Dangerous Goods are strictly prohibited.
  • 7.2. Dangerous Goods, other than those covered in article 6.1, may not be consigned to VIA without its prior written agreement and without the UTC or packages containing those Goods, as well as the Goods themselves, having been clearly marked on the outside so as to indicate their nature and hazardous character, in accordance with any laws or regulations that apply. At all events, the Customer is bound to make all the necessary declarations and to comply with all the conditions laid down by the national and international regulations in force for the carriage and storage of dangerous goods. The Customer is bound to collect any Dangerous Goods immediately at their arrival at the destination terminal. Failing which, VIA may take all the appropriate safety measures it considers necessary, at the Customer’s cost and risk. The carriage of Dangerous Goods will entail application of a surcharge in addition to the cost of carriage.
  • 7.3. Live animals are not authorized.
  • 7.4.Jewellery, pearls and precious stones, works of art, precious metals, bank notes, coins, checks, bank cards are excluded, except with VIA’s prior written agreement.
  • 7.5. The Customer is responsible for insuring the contents of the Loading Unit against loss, damage, or theft. The Customer is solely responsible for insuring the contents of the Loading Unit against any potential loss, damage, or theft during transportation.

sections.title: 8. Force Majeure
sections.html: SDG Railway will not be liable for any delay, failure, or interruption of services due to force majeure events, such as natural disasters, labor strikes, or governmental actions that are beyond its reasonable control.

sections.title: 9. Confidentiality
sections.html: Both the Customer and SDG Railway agree to keep confidential any information shared during the course of the Contract unless required by law or with the other party’s written consent.

sections.title: 10. Applicable law and jurisdiction
sections.html: The Contract is governed by the laws of the jurisdiction where SDG Railway is located, and any disputes arising from the Contract shall be resolved in the courts of that jurisdiction.

sections.title: 11. Entire agreement
sections.html: The Contract contains the entire understanding and agreement between the Customer and SDG Railway Service and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous agreements, understandings, or representations, whether written or oral, relating to the subject matter of the Contract.

sections.title: 12. Amendments
sections.html: Any amendments or modifications to the Contract must be made in writing and signed by both parties. No oral or implied agreements shall be binding unless confirmed in writing and signed by both the Customer and SDG Railway.

sections.title: 13. Waivers
sections.html: The failure of either party to enforce any provision of the Contract shall not be deemed a waiver of such provision or right. Any waiver of a provision or right must be in writing and signed by the party granting the waiver.

sections.title: 14. Severability
sections.html: If any provision of the Contract is found to be invalid or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, the remaining provisions of the Contract shall remain in full force and effect, and the invalid or unenforceable provision shall be replaced with a valid and enforceable provision that achieves the original intent of the parties to the extent possible.

sections.title: 15. Assignments
sections.html: The Customer may not assign or transfer any rights or obligations under the Contract without the prior written consent of SDG Railway. SDG Railway may assign or transfer its rights and obligations under the Contract to a third party with written notice to the Customer.

sections.title: 16. Notices
sections.html: All notices or communications required or permitted under the Contract shall be in writing and delivered by registered mail, courier, or email to the addresses specified in the Contract or as otherwise designated in writing by the parties.

sections.title: 17. Headings
sections.html: The headings in the Contract are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation or construction of the Contract.

sections.title: 18. Survivals
sections.html: Any provisions of the Contract that, by their nature, should survive termination or expiration of the Contract, including but not limited to payment terms, liability, confidentiality, and applicable law and jurisdiction, shall survive termination or expiration of the Contract.

sections.title: 19. Languages
sections.html: The Contract is written in English and any translations are for reference only. In case of any discrepancy between the original language version and any translations, the original language version shall prevail.

sections.title: 20. Executions
sections.html: This Contract may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Facsimile or electronic signatures shall be deemed original signatures for the purposes of this Contract.
